snippet.title: Zenless Zone Zero TGA 2025 Special Video
snippet.description:
"Every chosen heir of the Qingming Sword is expected to become a hero."
"I'm not fighting alone! From within this sword, many others are fighting beside me..."
The final battle is about to begin...

"Um... we'll be meeting everyone pretty soon... We're the Angels of Delusion, and if it's not too much trouble... could you all please follow our official account @AOD_EN_Official? Thank you... (´•̥ ̯•̥`)"
https://www.youtube.com/@AOD_EN_Official
